// Probe → tests/unit/score-containment.test.ts (JSX_PROP + the widened IDS). Read by the
// test directly; not copied anywhere.
//
// The EXACT shape that shipped on /insights/book until 2026-09-15 (PW-VOICE-01 B-V14):
// a SUM of protection-score points, handed to a presentational component as a PROP on a
// multi-line element, under a label that never says «σκορ». Two nets missed it — the
// identifier was unknown, and JSX_RENDER only sees interpolations next to a tag boundary.
export function ProbePointsTile({ overview, t }: { overview: { recoverablePoints: number }; t: (el: string, en: string) => string }) {
    return (
        <dl>
            <Stat
                label={t("Ανακτήσιμες μονάδες", "Recoverable points")}
                value={overview.recoverablePoints}
                tone="good"
            />
        </dl>
    )
}
